opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__facts: By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant- Pintu, who is involved in Case Crime No. 503 of 2021, under Sections 363, 366A, 376(3) I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Sahaswan, District- Buduan, seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__arguments:
Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that as per ossification test report dated 18.12.2021 of the victim, her radiological age is about 16 years.
It is also pointed out that as per Transfer Certificate of Class VIIth of the victim, her date of birth is 07.07.2009 and according to which also the victim is minor, which is also the part of the case diary.
It is also submitted that victim in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has made serious allegation of rape against the applicant.
Therefore, considering the gravity of offence, the bail application of the applicant is liable to be rejected.
opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__ANALYSIS:
So far as delay of three days in lodging F.I.R. is concerned
, it is well settled that in the sexual offences cases, the delay in lodging F.I.R. is immaterial.
Considering the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. of the victim, I find that she, in her statement has given vivid description of the incident, making allegation inter-alia of rape on her by the applicant.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the submissions advanced on behalf of parties, gravity of offence, role assigned to applicant, severity of punishment and report of the trial Court, I do not find any good ground to release the applicant on bail.
opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__decision:
Accordingly, the bail application is rejected at this stage.
It is made clear that the observation contained in the instant order is confined to the issue of bail and shall not affect the merit of the trial.
